recipe.title: Hazelnut choc chip cookies
recipe.notes: I got this recipe from Kristina White, a 2016-17 summer clerk at Russell McVeagh. Note the chilling time before cooking.

i.n: eggs, large [UNTESTED: "or 3 small", according to Kristina]
hazelnut block chocolate, broken into chips (cut the hazelnuts in half)

method.s: Cream the butter and sugar by hand.
Mix in eggs, one at a time, and salt.
Fold in flour and chocolate chips.
Cover the dough and chill for 15 mins to an hour.
Form into balls, flatten slightly and fan bake for 12 minutes at 180 deg C.
